about.en: MVLL is the GraniteShares 2x Long MRVL Daily ETF, a leveraged single-stock exchange-traded fund sponsored by GraniteShares that seeks twice (2x) the daily performance of the common shares of Marvell Technology, Inc. (MRVL) before fees and expenses. Because the leverage resets daily, returns compound and can diverge substantially from 2x the share's performance over periods longer than one day. It is listed on Nasdaq and is not an investment in MRVL shares themselves.
